_note: What you see: One programme: level, duration, pathway, start, location and crebo, what you learn, what your week looks like at school and at the training company, and admission.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Eén opleiding: niveau, duur, leerweg, start, locatie en crebo, wat je leert, hoe je week eruitziet op school en bij het leerbedrijf, en de toelating.
Je bouwt, test en onderhoudt machines wa: You build, test and maintain machines in which mechanics, electronics and control come together. From year 2 you do that three days a week at a training company.
Onderdelen maken en machines opbouwen ui: Making parts and building machines from a drawing.
Pneumatiek, hydrauliek en elektrische aa: Connecting and adjusting pneumatics, hydraulics and electric drives.
Dit is de BOL. In de BBL werk je vier da: This is the BOL. In the BBL you work four days and go to school one day.
4 dagen per week, met je proeve van bekw: 4 days a week, with your proficiency test
Je hebt een vmbo-diploma van de kaderber: You have a vmbo diploma from the kader, gemengd or theoretisch pathway. Or an MBO diploma at level 3.
Je gaat aan het werk als mechatronicus o: You go to work as a mechatronics or service technician. Or you continue at hbo, for example Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering.
De opleiding start in augustus 2027. Mel: The programme starts in augustus 2027. Register before 1 april 2027 and you are entitled to a place.
Eerst komen kijken?: Come and have a look first?
Open dag: zaterdag 7 november 2026, 10.0: Open day: zaterdag 7 november 2026, 10.00 to 14.00. Or shadow a second-year student for a day.
Ruud Hermans, docent mechatronica, helpt: Ruud Hermans, mechatronics teacher, helps you further:
